failures.title: Types > isBlob > valid cases
failures.message: expected false to be true // Object.is equality
failures.reason: Runtime `Blob` is missing `Symbol.toStringTag`, so `Object.prototype.toString.call(blob)` returns `[object Object]`. This deviates from the File API spec; the fix belongs in the runtime.

failures.title: IterAsync Helpers > New Iter Utilities > fromIterAsync
failures.message: expected false to be true // Object.is equality
failures.reason: Runtime does not perform `IteratorClose` when a `for await...of` loop exits early, so a `finally` block in an async generator never runs. Required by ECMA-262; the equivalent sync `for...of` path is handled correctly. The fix belongs in the runtime.

failures.title: Number > formatCompact
failures.reason: Number formatting needs `Intl.NumberFormat`. Runtimes built without ICU cannot format compact notation or currencies.
